entries.author: YakiSauce
entries.current_title: Show HN: I built a virtual tabletop for playing Dungeons and Dragons
entries.excerpt: Diceright is a virtual tabletop for playing dungeons and dragons with friends on the web. You can watch a quick overview of how it works here: https://tinyurl.com/diceright . And there’s a list of the main features right on the homepage. It’s a Ruby on Rails site that makes heavy use of action cable for keeping the maps and tokens in sync for all players. entries.title: Show HN: Firefox add-on to open YouTube videos in alternative front ends
entries.author: d3vr
entries.current_title: Show HN: Firefox add-on to open YouTube videos in alternative front ends
entries.excerpt: YouTube started blocking me because I use an adblocker. So I made this simple Firefox Add-On (haven't made it cross-browser yet, contributions welcome!) to open videos in alternative front-ends (piped.video by default). Default keybinding: Alt+J to reopen current page in the configured frontend. Shift+Click to open any video in a new tab in the configured frontend. You can change the default frontend to something else if you like.
entries.guide_zh: Firefox 扩展把 YouTube 视频打开到替代前端，回应广告拦截被限制的体验。
